articles.title: Crypto Group Warns Regulators Against Expanding Stablecoin KYC
articles.description: The crypto trade group warned that forcing issuers to verify identities for peer-to-peer wallet transfers would “cripple the industry” as regulators implement the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller leads doubters who think Bessent's bond ploys will fail
articles.description: The bond market interventions have generated a modest decline in yields along with a growing chorus of derision.

articles.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
articles.description: The trading infrastructure runs on LayerZero's Zero blockchain, backed by Citadel Securities with DTCC and ICE exploring institutional market applications.

articles.title: World Liberty Financial CEO Zach Witkoff says success of stablecoin silences charge of Trump cronyism
articles.description: Zach Witkoff, CEO of Trump-linked World Liberty Financial, said conflict-of-interest concerns related to the Trump family are misplaced.

articles.title: Canada unveils retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of U.S. goods
articles.description: Canadian trade negotiators left the U.S. last week after failing to clinch a trade deal that would stop President Donald Trump's new tariffs from taking effect.

articles.title: China needs U.S. dollars but is building a hedge against Washington’s sanctions
articles.description: The U.S. can pressure Chinese banks over Iran through access to its financial system, while Beijing is building alternatives such as CIPS.

articles.title: DGrid AI token jumps 93% after launch as decentralized AI network goes live
articles.description: DGAI nearly doubled in its first day of trading as DGrid expands its distributed AI inference network and rolls out hardware for its personal AI agent.

articles.title: Cash is no longer king in home sales
articles.description: Cash buyers are a diminishing share of the overall housing market, as more supply and weaker prices give them more purchasing power.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says this could be the key to sending Apple shares higher
articles.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

articles.title: Oil drops 3% as U.S. shifts to economic pressure on Iran, easing fears of renewed war
articles.description: Investors shrugged off the latest developments in the U.S.-Iran war.

articles.title: The 'debasement trade' returns after Bessent bond maneuver. Crypto and gold are back in style
articles.description: Concern over the size and the cost of U.S. government spending has given new life to the debasement trade.

articles.title: Bitcoin slips from $80K as gold cools with falling US bond yields
articles.description: Bitcoin bulls battled for control of the $80,000 zone as gold came off its highest levels since mid-May on falling US bond yields.

articles.title: Crypto Fund Founder Convicted of Fraud Over Fake Trading Bot
articles.description: Japheth Dillman told investors that Block Bits Capital's "Autotrader" software was finished and running, and took nearly $1 million.

articles.title: Bitwise turns Coinbase's tokenized stocks into automated AI, robotics and tech portfolios

articles.title: Dick's Sporting Goods stock falls 25% as retailer misses expectations, cites 'challenging' footwear market
articles.description: Dick's Sporting Goods reported fiscal second-quarter earnings on Tuesday that missed Wall Street expectations amid what it called a "challenging" environment.

articles.title: Nvidia’s dependence on hyperscalers faces big test in earnings report
articles.description: Nvidia is trying to expand its customer base by creating new financing options that allow for more clients to purchase its costly systems.

articles.title: Dozens of Fake Firefox Wallet Extensions Linked to Crypto-Stealing Malware
articles.description: Forty are confirmed malicious, impersonating OKX, Rabby and TronLink to harvest recovery phrases from anyone who types one in.

articles.title: Arcus launches tokenized perp positions on Robinhood Chain
articles.description: Arcus introduced transferable ERC-20 tokens for perpetual positions and lets tokenized stocks back leveraged trades without requiring users to sell their holdings.

articles.title: Crypto custody firm Copper has potential buyers. But offers are way below its $500 million asking price
articles.description: Once valued at $2.5 billion, Copper was being marketed by investment bank Cantor Fitzgerald at around $500 million in May this year.

articles.title: Hugging Face hack exposes the open-weight AI cybersecurity paradox
articles.description: Hugging Face relies on open weight Chinese models to defend itself from rogue AI agents. But a lack of safety guardrails makes those models potentially dangerous too.
